Rackwell, at-home dumbbell strength app. Our team is in Austin, but the app is sold nationwide: anyone in the United States can sign up, not just people in Austin. iPhone only. Back-to-school push runs Wednesday, July 28, 2027 through Saturday, July 31, 2027, Central time. Goal: as many free-trial starts as possible. Trial starts are what we count. Landing page: https://rackwellapp.com/trial. No X pixel on the site, so X won't see the trial starts. Here's the copy from our landing page: "Rackwell is an at-home strength app with 25-minute dumbbell plans that fit a dorm room, a garage or a living room floor. Start a 14-day free trial, cancel anytime before it ends and pay nothing. Available on iPhone (iOS) only, for anyone in the United States." You can launch and manage it yourself, no need to check with us first. Keep an eye on it through the flight. When it ends, send a short recap with spend, impressions and link clicks.

Total budget: 450.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 5 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:
